name: muster
title: Muster (Mobile Ops)
description: Grid-down operations control, reachable on any phone/tablet on the LAN with zero install. Pulls real messages and map markers from WayStation over its own WSP/1 protocol.
notes: Real setup required beyond enabling this module: WayStation must be running and reachable, and its operator must register this station as a trusted WSP/1 peer (WayStation's own Settings → Peer Sync) using the exact callsign/secret set in .env as MUSTER_CALLSIGN/MUSTER_SECRET, plus WAYSTATION_HOST pointing at the machine WayStation actually runs on. Without that, the module runs but honestly reports 'not connected' rather than showing fake data.
